title: SCHC Version 3 Rule 1 and 6 address prefixes diverge across Rust Python and spec
description: Rust generic descriptors use fd00::/64 for Rules 1 and 6, Python and Rust whole-packet codec use the canonical Yggdrasil 0200::/8 model, while spec/03 still describes mesh /64 compression. Align descriptors and normative spec with 0200::/8 and test generic descriptors against whole-packet vectors.
notes:
UPDATE: Per decision on worker6-vdon, LICHEN is adopting full Yggdrasil AddrForKey compatibility. Address space is now 0200::/7 (both 02xx and 03xx), not 0200::/8. SCHC Rules 1 and 6 MUST accept both first-byte values. This bead is blocked until the Yggdrasil address implementations land (worker6-yjg6, worker6-4tji, worker6-4bju, worker6-lqzm).
2026-09-08 OVERRIDING ADJUDICATION: Mark reaffirmed upstream Yggdrasil addressing EVERYWHERE. See upstream-yggdrasil-addressing in spec/decisions.jsonl and Settled Protocol Decisions in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. This supersedes conflicting descriptions/notes/closures that bless SHA-512 native addressing, require preserving its bytes or IID-equality invariant, or call for blanket /8-to-/7 replacement. Node /128 MUST equal upstream AddrForKey(key) in 0200::/8. Routed /64, when used, MUST equal upstream SubnetForKey(key) in 0300::/8; 0200::/7 is the aggregate only. Standard link-local/multicast control retains scope. Follow exact pinned upstream source, not the abbreviated algorithm in old issues. Conformance oracle is independently obtained byte-equality vectors from yggdrasil-go revision 422836eeb21a99790caa286aa63d493bbc4766d7 (address.go/address_test.go), not agreement among LICHEN implementations. Report conflicting old tests/fixtures; do not weaken tests or generate expected results from code under test. Classify node versus subnet traffic correctly in routing/SCHC without altering upstream identities. Breaking address changes were already accepted in worker6-vdon. Existing migration work is incomplete; this annotation does not claim it is fixed. Scope origin: project-LICHEN-worker6-rmjn.
